key_insight: Constrained Deep Ritz solvers outperform the tested neural-network alternatives for 1D soliton profiles, with the Weinstein variant offering the best error–runtime balance.
engineering_relevance: These mesh-free solvers offer a proof of concept for extending stationary nonlinear-wave computations to higher dimensions and more complex operators.
method: Enhance Adam-trained PINNs with Gauss–Newton/Levenberg–Marquardt, L-BFGS refinements, and Fourier features.
Learn profile amplitude through Nehari/Pokhozhaev projection in a constrained Deep Ritz formulation.
Minimize the Weinstein quotient using a normalized neural-network profile.
evidence_signal: Explicit sech-type solutions provide exact references for error measurement and hyperparameter benchmarking; Deep Ritz performs best among the neural solvers tested.
watch_item: Classical Petviashvili iteration remains more accurate and efficient in 1D; advantages in higher dimensions are not established here.
paper_title: Soliton Profiles in 1D: Enhanced Neural-Network Solvers and Constrained Deep Ritz Methods
